title: Spec: 08 GCP-7 Node Handoff
description: Node handoff protocol when nodes move between gateway coverage: DAO to new gateway, POST /handoff to old gateway via backbone, state transfer (sequence numbers, security contexts), RPL DODAG route update.
close_reason: Already fixed: Node Handoff (GCP-7) fully implemented in Python (573 lines, 33 passing tests), Rust (1288 lines), and Zephyr C (1083 lines). Protocol covers DAO to new gateway, POST /handoff, state transfer (OSCORE/sequence numbers), and route updates.
